cached_values: Immutable CPU float32 quality-weighted Raw group mean, mean quality and observed count, using exact original Torch operation/order. No learned/adapted embedding, GT, ID, role, logits, token or memory assignment in keys/values.
eviction: ONLY derived statistics; cache misses and oversize recompute exact original values. All actual members/commits/versions/tombstones remain untouched; same whole support bounds/no pruning.
scope: Identical payloads may share derived values but remain separate input rows in different alias/video/frame groups. Fresh output tensors prevent mutation/autograd cache corruption.
before_integration: Do not edit live worker dependencies. Require separately registered all-prefix numerical byte equality on qualified actual inputs and full controller shadow/source qualification. Preserve any old resource failure; no silent wall/RAM/coverage limit relaxation.
